question: What is the meaning of target density in relation to technical information?
description: Density in relation to technical information refers to the measure of cohesiveness or link strength of the keywords within a cluster or theme. It indicates the level of development of a research theme based on how closely related and interconnected the keywords are within that specific cluster or theme.
